prompt: What causes Quick Sort to degrade to its worst-case O(n²) time complexity?
options: Choosing the median element as pivot
Array containing only distinct random elements
Splitting the array into equal halves
Consistently selecting the minimum or maximum element as the pivot
explanation: When the pivot does not partition elements into balanced sub-arrays (e.g. partition of size 0 and n-1), recursion depth reaches n, requiring n + (n-1) + ... + 1 = O(n²) comparisons.
